title: Wso2am: Improper encoding of non-finite floating-point values during MapMessage JSON serialization in Apache Log4j API…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package involves improper encoding of non-finite floating-point values during MapMessage JSON serialization in the Apache Log4j API. This flaw results in output that is not valid JSON, potentially impacting data integrity. The issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in these versions.
